interpretation_constraints: This is a fixed-feature, inference-only diagnostic; no structural-basis or bilevel task training was performed.
Only top-1 proposals enter RANSAC; top-2 is a coverage diagnostic, not geometric multi-hypothesis inference.
Search uses the host-selected angle. CPU window coverage at the nearest true angle does not prove coverage under that selected angle.
New points use 140x140 grid parabolic subcell refinement, not the native learned RoMa refiner.
C6a_pair_bce_samecompute is iteration-capped L-BFGS-B; call it same-iteration, not compute-matched.
Symmetric fallback is a post-hoc sensitivity analysis of observed outputs, not an executed new experiment.
Missing task outputs count as failures. Missing oracle measurements have availability counts and bounds.
Cluster bootstrap describes core-macro paired differences on observed data; reused DEV is not independent confirmation.
